verdict: Ads are running and converting, but leads aren't reaching your CRM.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Google Ads recorded 16 conversions on $1,698.97 in spend — the ads themselves are working. However, none of those conversions are showing up as leads in your contact system, which means inquiries are being lost somewhere between the ad click and your inbox; this is an intake routing issue, not an ads problem. At the same time, your Google Business Profile engagement dropped 51.6% week-over-week, with zero actions recorded in the last three days, pointing to softening local visibility that we're monitoring closely. We're actively tracing and repairing the path between your ad conversions and your CRM so that every inquiry is captured going forward. By end of August, several pieces come online — a review campaign, the Homer Glen branch page, and the financing page — that are expected to strengthen both your local presence and lead flow heading into heating season.
